risk_notes: Creates a Docker container named local-store-memos.
Stores the SQLite database and uploaded assets in the Local Store app directory.
Starts in private mode; the first user becomes the Memos administrator.
compose:
services:
  memos:
    image: neosmemo/memos:0.30.0
    container_name: local-store-memos
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5230:5230"
    environment:
      MEMOS_PORT: "5230"
      MEMOS_DRIVER: sqlite
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/opt/memos
